info.description:
Generated from docs/api/openapi.yaml by `go generate ./docs/api` — do not edit by hand.

Auth: run **Auth › Login** first; the server sets the HttpOnly `ts_session` cookie and Postman's cookie jar sends it on every later request (there is no bearer token). Requests that create rows save their ids (e.g. `shiftId`) for the get / update / delete requests after them. Running the whole collection writes to the database: use a development database.
